sections.content:
The right green (id=8) is still at [33-35, 21-23] - it didn't move RIGHT at all! This is very strange. The right green seems to be stuck at this position and can't move in any direction.
Wait, looking at the image, the right green is at [33-35, 21-23], which is in the protrusion area. But the protrusion is at rows 30-32, and the green is at rows 33-35. So the green is below the protrusion, in the main body of the left panel.
But the green can't move RIGHT, LEFT, UP, or DOWN. This suggests that the green is "locked" in place, or that the movement actions only affect a specific green (the one that was last clicked or selected).
Wait, maybe the movement actions only affect the "selected" green, and the selection changed when I moved the right green earlier. Let me think about this...
Earlier, I was moving the right green (which was in the gap between the left panel and the purple bar). I moved it LEFT into the left panel, then DOWN and RIGHT, and it ended up at [33-35, 21-23]. Now the right green is stuck there.
But the left green is at [33-35, 12-14], inside the left dark square. Maybe the movement actions are now affecting the left green, not the right green. Let me check if the left green moved.
Actually, the left green is still at [33-35, 12-14], so it didn't move either. This suggests that the movement actions are not affecting any green, or that both greens are stuck.
Wait, maybe the movement actions only affect the green that is NOT inside a dark square. The left green is inside the left dark square, so it can't be moved. The right green is not inside any dark square, so it should be movable. But the right green is stuck at [33-35, 21-23] and can't move.
This is very confusing. Let me try a different approach: maybe I need to use MOUSE to click on the right green to "select" it, and then the movement actions will affect it. Let me try clicking the right green and then moving it.
Actually, I already clicked the right green earlier (at row 34, col 22), and it didn't change anything. But maybe the click "selected" the green, and now the movement actions should affect it. But the movement actions didn't move the green.
Let me try clicking the right green again and then immediately moving it.
